dataset.name: bpRNA-new
dataset.input_order: Frozen JSONL order and unique names are preserved
dataset.pair_output: Zero-based inclusive i<j; one partner per base; AU/CG/GU only; j-i>3; crossing pairs are not filtered
dataset.label_boundary: Reference pairs are checked for input-contract integrity only. They are not model inputs, decoder inputs, tuning targets, or substitutes for predictions. No external Test set was read for tuning.

single_model_identity.checkpoint_loading: One named checkpoint, mandatory SHA256, torch.load(weights_only=True), strict state-dict load, eval mode
single_model_identity.official_output_adapter: Official contact2ct, then strict mutual-CT to zero-based pair conversion; invalid pairs fail without repair

static_environment.official_historical_environment: Python 3.7.3, PyTorch 1.2.0, CUDA 9.2 from official environment.yml; not created or used for inference here

resource_requirements.execution: One CUDA GPU, batch size 1, padded length 600, serial 5388-sequence replay
resource_requirements.memory_and_runtime: NOT_MEASURED. Parameter size is only a static lower bound and excludes activations, attention, postprocessing, CUDA context, and driver overhead. Run only after current GPU jobs finish and sufficient free memory is confirmed.
resource_requirements.storage: Official source archive and extraction are under the designated data root; checkpoint size is unknown because no checkpoint was recovered. Large assets and future predictions remain outside Git.
